Perceptions and Adaptation to Climate Change: the Case of Peruvian Farmers
venue: Journal of Economics and Development Studies
abstract: Rice cultivation in Peru exemplifies the complex nature of the interaction between changing climatic conditions and households' decisions on how to cope with these changes in the face of multiple constraints. In this study, we examine how climatic conditions affect these decisions. We account for the fact that this relationship is mediated by the perceptions that individuals have about climatic conditions, which can be highly heterogeneous at the local level. We focus on small-scale household farmers in Peru who depend on rice production for their livelihoods. We first examine men's and women's perceptions of climatic changes and compare them to aggregate and weather station information regarding changes in climatic indicators. Second, we examine the various adaptation strategies used by rice farmers to cope with climate change. We estimate a multivariate probit regression model, in order to understand patterns of coping behavior and the factors associated with them.
abstract_zh: 秘鲁的水稻种植生动地体现了气候条件变化与农户在多重约束下如何应对这些变化的决策之间复杂的相互作用。本研究考察了气候条件如何影响这些决策。我们考虑到，这种关系是由个人对气候条件的感知所调节的，而这些感知在地方层面可能高度异质。我们关注依赖水稻生产维持生计的秘鲁小农户。首先，我们考察男性和女性对气候变化的感知，并将其与总体信息以及气象站关于气候指标变化的信息进行比较。其次，我们考察水稻农户为应对气候变化所采取的各种适应策略。我们估计了多元 Probit 回归模型，以理解应对行为的模式及其相关因素。

title: [FE1091] Regulations Governing the Usage of Reclaimed Water as an Alternative Water Source for Agricultural Irrigation in Florida
abstract: Fresh water is becoming increasing scarce as the world population grows rapidly. Reclaimed water from alternative sources can be used to help offset the demand for fresh surface water and groundwater in agriculture. To ensure that pathogenic or trace chemical constituents in reclaimed water do not pose a threat to human health and the environment, state and federal governments impose regulations governing reclaimed water use. This fact sheet documents the rules and regulations governing the use of reclaimed water from alternative water sources in Florida agriculture. Target audiences include growers exploring alternative water use for agriculture, non-core professionals, core professionals, and the public.
abstract_zh: 随着世界人口快速增长，淡水资源日益稀缺。来自替代水源的再生水，可用于减轻农业对地表淡水和地下水的需求。为确保再生水中的病原体或痕量化学物质不会对人类健康和环境构成威胁，州和联邦政府出台了规范再生水利用的法规。本简报梳理了佛罗里达州农业中利用替代水源再生水所适用的规章制度。目标读者包括探索在农业中利用替代水源的种植者、非核心专业人员、核心专业人员以及公众。

title: Aligning Strategic Objectives with Research and Development Activities in a Soft Commodity Sector: A Technological Plan for Colombian Cocoa Producers
Differences in women’s and men’s conservation of cacao agroforests in coastal Ecuador
abstract: Stakeholder preferences for the conservation of cacao agroforests are scarcely known. Here, a revealed preference model was used to estimate the value that smallholders place on the conservation of their cacao agroforests in coastal Ecuador. Variables in the model included plot-level data (the gender of those who owned and managed the plot, profit, land title and years of ownership) and household demographic data (ages, educational levels and wealth indicators). Households were willing to give up some profit to conserve agroforests especially if they had managed the plot longer. Furthermore, when women were included in the management of a plot, the household was more likely to conserve the cacao agroforest, but the gender of the person who owns the plot had no effect on the probability of conserving the agroforest. These findings provide further evidence of the gender differences in preferences for agroforests and that more inclusive land-use decisions may lead to the use of more sustainable farming practices. They also demonstrate that policies that encourage inclusive land ownership do not necessarily ensure equal gender participation in plot decision-making and management.
abstract_zh: 关于利益相关方对可可农林复合系统（cacao agroforests）保护的偏好，人们所知甚少。本研究采用显示性偏好模型，估算厄瓜多尔沿海小农户对其可可农林复合系统保护所赋予的价值。模型中的变量包括地块层面的数据（拥有和管理地块者的性别、利润、土地产权和拥有年限）以及家庭人口统计数据（年龄、教育水平和财富指标）。农户愿意放弃部分利润以保护农林复合系统，特别是在他们管理该地块时间较长的情况下。此外，当妇女参与某地块的管理时，家庭保护可可农林复合系统的可能性更高，但地块所有者的性别对保护农林复合系统的概率没有影响。这些发现进一步证明了人们在农林复合系统偏好上存在性别差异，并表明更具包容性的土地利用决策可能有助于采用更可持续的农业做法。研究还表明，鼓励包容性土地所有权的政策，并不一定能确保地块决策和管理中的性别平等参与。

title: Moving toward Sustainable Rice Production in Northwest Dominican Republic
abstract: Pesticide runoff from the rice production area of Las Matas de Santa Cruz in NW Dominican Republic degrades biodiversity in the ecosystems of the Yaque del Norte River, Montecristi National Park, and Caribbean Sea. This degradation prompted the Dominican NGO AgroFrontera to develop a program for the creation of a new sustainable rice value chain, starting with the formation of a rice growers association in Las Matas. This project was to evaluate “organic” as a potential certification for the new growers association. The project found that while organic certification is years away, other barriers to a sustainable rice value chain exist: competition with US rice imports due to Dominican Republic-Central American Free Trade Agreement (DR-CAFTA), an informal labor system, and access to credit. Recommendations for the new growers association include: to lower the cost of production to compete with imports, to formalize the labor system, to mediate financing for rice producers, and to maintain balanced leverage across the value chain. A recommendation for future research is the resiliency of farmer institutions against internal corruption and in-fighting.
abstract_zh: 多米尼加共和国西北部 Las Matas de Santa Cruz 稻作区的农药径流，正在破坏亚基河（Yaque del Norte River）、蒙特克里斯蒂国家公园（Montecristi National Park）和加勒比海的生态系统生物多样性。这一退化状况促使多米尼加非政府组织 AgroFrontera 制定了一项计划，旨在创建一条新的可持续稻米价值链，其起点是在 Las Matas 组建一个稻农协会。该项目原本要评估“有机”认证能否作为新稻农协会的潜在认证。项目发现，尽管有机认证尚需数年时间才能实现，但可持续稻米价值链还存在其他障碍：来自美国的稻米进口竞争（多米尼加共和国—中美洲自由贸易协定，DR-CAFTA）、非正式的劳动制度，以及获得信贷的途径。针对新稻农协会的建议包括：降低生产成本以应对进口竞争；使劳动制度正规化；为稻米生产者提供融资协调；并在价值链各环节保持均衡的议价能力。对未来研究的一项建议是，考察农民组织抵御内部腐败和内斗的韧性。

title: A Framework for Determining the Impact of Value Chain Participation on Smallholder Farm Efficiency
abstract: We analyze the efficiency of wheat farmers toward the ever-increasing demand for wheat in Tanzania. Translog production and cost functions were utilized in the stochastic frontier analysis to examine technical, allocative, and economic efficiencies (TE, AE, and EE) of wheat farmers in Northern Tanzania. Propensity score matching through caliper radius and nearest neighbor methods were utilized to analyze the impact of value chain participation on smallholder farm efficiency levels. Analysis revealed that the average TE, AE, and EE scores for farmers’ value chain participation were 79%, 80%, and 64%, respectively, in the study area, implying that wheat farmers could still improve level of TE, AE, and EE by 21%, 20%, and 36%, respectively. Caliper radius matching revealed that the net effects of farmers’ participation in vertical coordination on TE, AE, and EE were 6.8%, 5.7%, and 8.7%, respectively, while the net effects of farmers’ horizontal coordination participation were 6.3%, 9.5%, and 11.6%, respectively. This indicates that farmer’s participation in value chain (vertical and horizontal coordination) would positively impact their level of wheat farm efficiencies. Based on the results, we recommend the expansion of wheat plots and use of modern farming technologies to increase wheat production in Tanzania. To further improve farm unit efficiency, we recommend additional formal education for future farmers, more on-farm extension training, and participation in the value chain through contracts and farmers’ associations.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了坦桑尼亚小麦农户为满足日益增长的小麦需求而展现的生产效率。在坦桑尼亚北部的研究区域，我们采用超越对数（translog）生产函数和成本函数，并运用随机前沿分析方法，考察小麦农户的技术效率、配置效率和经济效率（分别记为TE、AE和EE）。我们运用卡尺半径法和最近邻法进行倾向得分匹配，以分析价值链参与对小农户农场效率水平的影响。分析显示，参与价值链的农户的平均TE、AE和EE得分分别为79%、80%和64%，这意味着小麦农户的TE、AE和EE仍可分别提高21%、20%和36%。卡尺半径匹配结果显示，纵向协调参与对TE、AE和EE的净效应分别为6.8%、5.7%和8.7%，横向协调参与的净效应分别为6.3%、9.5%和11.6%。这表明，农户参与价值链（纵向和横向协调）将对其小麦生产效率产生积极影响。基于研究结果，我们建议扩大小麦种植面积，并采用现代农业技术以提高坦桑尼亚的小麦产量。为进一步提高农场单位效率，我们建议为未来农民提供更多正规教育，增加农场内的推广培训，并通过合同和农民协会参与价值链。

Women’s Participation in Agriculture and Gender Productivity Gap: The Case of Coffee Farmers in Southern Colombia and Northern Ecuador
abstract: This study examines the intra-household bargaining its impact on the productivity of coffee and other crops functions and on the gender productivity gap, using household-level data from 615 farmers in Colombia and Ecuador. The OLS estimates and the Oaxaca-Blinder (O-B) decomposition method corroborate the hypothesis that given a gain bargaining power through the distribution factor “female participation in the intra-household decision-making” would exacerbate household productivity and the gender gap as long this bargaining is not balanced and wives do not obtain fair benefits from agricultural activities. The results also confirm that differences in observed factors between female and male-headed households are the main reason for the gender gap.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用来自哥伦比亚和厄瓜多尔 615 名农户的家庭层面数据，考察了家庭内部议价及其对咖啡和其他作物生产函数的影响，以及对性别生产率差距的影响。OLS 估计和 Oaxaca-Blinder（O-B）分解方法证实了这一假设：如果妇女在家庭内部决策中的参与（即分配因子）赋予其更多议价能力，那么只要这种议价不均衡、妻子无法从农业活动中获得公平收益，就会加剧家庭生产率和性别差距。结果还证实，女性户主家庭与男性户主家庭在可观测因素上的差异，是造成性别差距的主要原因。

title: Gendered Perceptions of Land Ownership and Agricultural Decision-making in Ecuador: Who Are the Farm Managers?
abstract: This paper challenges standard analyses of gender differences in agriculture, which typically focus on the sex of household heads or landholders, by considering who makes decisions on land owned by married women. We show that joint ownership and joint decision-making by couples is common in Ecuador but would be overlooked in studies focusing on only one farm manager. We also show that there are gender differences in perceptions about land ownership and agricultural decision-making, with men reporting lower levels of women’s participation compared to their wives’ report. Moreover, perceptions about the factors affecting women’s participation in agricultural decision-making also differ. (JEL D63, Q15)
abstract_zh: 现有的农业性别差异分析通常关注户主或土地持有人的性别，本文对此提出了挑战，转而考察已婚妇女所拥有土地的决策者是谁。我们发现，在厄瓜多尔，夫妻共同拥有土地和共同决策的情况十分普遍，而仅关注单一农场经营者的研究会忽略这一点。我们还发现，在土地所有权和农业决策的感知上存在性别差异：男性报告的女性参与水平低于其妻子的自我报告。此外，人们对影响女性参与农业决策的因素的看法也存在差异。（JEL D63, Q15）

Differences in Opinions about Surface Water Quality Issues in the Southern United States: Implications for Watershed Planning Process
abstract: Public participation in a watershed planning process involves reaching out to social groups with very diverse opinions and perceptions about environmental issues. Using responses to a nationwide survey of public attitudes and perceptions related to water issues, we examined the effects of socio-demographic and residence characteristics on opinions about water quality, agricultural and urban pollution sources, and nutrients and pathogen pollution issues in the southern United States. Significant differences were identified among respondents of different age groups, genders, and educational levels. Opinions also differed significantly among urban and rural respondents and between states. These results can be used by state and local agencies, universities, and extension services involved in the design of collaborative watershed management processes and water resource educational efforts.
abstract_zh: 在流域规划过程中，公众参与需要接触持有各种不同意见和观念的社会群体，他们对环境问题有着十分多元的看法。本研究利用一项全国性调查的数据，即关于水问题的公众态度和认知调查，考察了社会人口和居住特征对美国南部地区水质、农业和城市污染源以及营养物质与病原体污染问题的看法的影响。研究发现，不同年龄组、性别和教育水平的受访者之间存在显著差异。城乡受访者之间以及不同州之间的看法也存在显著差异。这些结果可供参与协作式流域管理过程设计及水资源教育工作的州和地方机构、大学以及推广服务部门参考。

Exploring the effects of extension workshops on household water use behavior
abstract: The effectiveness of 2-hour extension workshops focused on residential water conservation is examined. We used a sample of irrigation water-use data for 57 workshop participants and 43 nonparticipants, and applied a fixed effect regression analysis method. The results show that the workshops were effective in reducing attendees’ irrigation water use; however, the effect was short-lived. Furthermore, the effect of the workshop attendance depended on the household sample considered, and for a subsample of low-use workshop participants, water use tended to increase following the workshop.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了专注于居民节水的 2 小时推广研讨会的效果。我们使用了 57 名研讨会参与者和 43 名非参与者的灌溉用水数据，并采用固定效应回归方法进行分析。结果表明，研讨会有效减少了参与者的灌溉用水量，但效果是短暂的。此外，研讨会参与的效果取决于所考察的家庭样本；在低用水量参与者的子样本中，研讨会之后用水量往往反而有所增加。

title: Early adoption, experience, and farm performance of GM corn seeds
abstract: The current article explores the characteristics that distinguish early from late adopters of GM corn and measures the productivity impacts of early adoption, for a sample of farmers in Minnesota and Wisconsin. The results of the adoption analysis confirm that size, education as well as specialization are positively correlated with early adoption. In addition, these results also show that farms that are mostly worked by family labor but hire some off‐farm labor are more likely to adopt GM seeds earlier in the diffusion process. The productivity analysis demonstrates the superiority of stacked varieties. At the same time, we find no evidence of a direct impact of experience on yields. Given the previously documented impact of early adoption on the use of stacked varieties, we conclude that experience plays a role through the adoption of these new technologies but does not play a role in allowing the producer to use the technology more efficiently, once it has been adopted.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了区分转基因玉米早期采用者与晚期采用者的特征，并测度早期采用的生产率影响，样本为明尼苏达州和威斯康星州的农户。采用分析结果证实，农场规模、教育水平以及生产专业化程度均与早期采用呈正相关。此外，这些结果还表明，主要依靠家庭劳动力但雇用部分场外劳动力的农场，在扩散过程中更有可能较早采用转基因种子。生产率分析显示了叠加性状品种（stacked varieties）的优越性。与此同时，我们没有发现经验对单产有直接影响的证据。鉴于此前已记录的早期采用对叠加性状品种使用的影响，我们得出结论：经验通过新技术的采用发挥作用，但在技术被采用之后，并不能帮助生产者更有效地使用该技术。

title: Sequential Adoption of Package Technologies: The Dynamics of Stacked Trait Corn Adoption
Integrating Technology Traits and Producer Heterogeneity: A Mixed‐Multinomial Model of Genetically Modified Corn Adoption
Technology Adoption in Poorly Specified Environments
abstract: This article extends the characteristics-based choice framework of technology adoption to account for decisions taken by boundedly-rational individuals in environments where traits are not fully observed. It is applied to an agricultural setting and introduces the concept of ambiguity in the agricultural technology adoption literature by relaxing strict informational and cognition related assumptions that are implied by traditional Bayesian analysis. The main results confirm that ambiguity increases as local conditions become less homogeneous and as computational ability, own experience and nearby adoption rates decrease. Measurement biases associated with full rationality assumptions are found to increase when decision makers have low computational ability, low experience and when their farming conditions differ widely from average adopter ones. A complementary empirical paper (Useche 2006) finds that models assuming low confidence in observed data, ambiguity and pessimistic expectations about traits predict sample shares better than models which assume that farmers do not face ambiguity or are optimistic about the traits of new varieties.
abstract_zh: 本文将技术采纳的特征选择框架加以拓展，以考虑在特征无法完全观测的环境中，有限理性个体所做出的决策。本文将该框架应用于农业情境，并通过放松传统贝叶斯分析所隐含的严格信息与认知假设，将模糊性（ambiguity）概念引入农业技术采纳文献。主要结果证实，当当地条件越不均匀、计算能力、自身经验和周边采纳率越低时，模糊性就越高。当决策者计算能力较低、经验较少，且其农业条件与平均采纳者的条件相差较大时，与完全理性假设相关的测量偏差会增大。一篇补充性的实证论文（Useche 2006）发现，与假设农民不面临模糊性或对新品种特征持乐观态度的模型相比，假设农民对观测数据信心不足、存在模糊性并对特征持悲观预期的模型，能更好地预测样本份额。
